Instructions for Use
Device description: The Kestrel Stent is a coronary stent. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Kestrel Stent is MR Conditional. A person with the Kestrel Stent may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Kestrel Stent
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 150 T/m/s per axis
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions B1+rms <= 2.4 uT
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 25 mm from the device.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
